stages.name: y
stages.what: whitened rfft window: re A, E, T, im A, E, T

stages.name: stft
stages.what: per token: asinh|z| and gated phase of its band's time samples

stages.name: tokens_y
stages.what: data tokens: y_embed (linear) + y_mlp(features of the token's lowest and highest f)

stages.name: c_f
stages.what: cos and sin of the window's lowest and highest f over freq_periods, into f_mlp -> data-stream conditioning [D]

stages.name: registers
stages.what: frame registers: c_f + frame_slot, one per f0-ordered source; they join the data tokens in encode

stages.name: cache
stages.what: keys (and values) of every block's data tokens then registers, per observation

stages.name: delta
stages.what: frame head: frame_modulation + frame_unembed of the registers, (delta_mu, delta_s) per source

stages.name: frame
stages.what: mu and log sigma of x1: the prior's moments shifted and scaled by delta

stages.name: z
stages.what: flow coordinates in the frame, x = mu + sigma z

stages.name: features_x
stages.what: z, x, radius cos kφ and sin kφ of both helicity amplitudes of x (k = 2..6), mu, log sigma

stages.name: f0_x
stages.what: cos and sin features of f0 in Hz, into f0_mlp

stages.name: tokens_x
stages.what: source tokens: x_embed (linear) + f0_mlp

stages.name: c
stages.what: sinusoids of t and log10(1 - t), into c_mlp, plus the window's f_mlp -> c [D]

stages.name: sinks
stages.what: attention sinks: c + s_slot

stages.name: keys
stages.what: keys each source/sink query attends: own S + Z, cached N data + S registers

stages.name: out
stages.what: mean and log std of z1 per source coordinate
